summary.title: Collections · {{period}}
summary.subtitle: What was billed, what came in, what waits for checking, and what is still owed. Every figure opens its records.
summary.progressAria: Settled {{collected}}, waiting for verification {{pending}}, still owed {{owed}}
summary.queueSubtitle: Proofs to check and bank lines to place, oldest first.
summary.agingSubtitle: What is still owed, by days past the due date.
summary.buildingsSubtitle: This month's bills and what each block has paid.
summary.queueAwaitingBank_one: {{count}} proof waiting for its bank line
summary.queueAwaitingBank_other: {{count}} proofs waiting for their bank line

page.intro: Residents' payments for the month: proofs to verify, the bank, receipts and arrears.

inbox.intro: Proofs residents sent, oldest first. A proof becomes a payment only when you verify it.
inbox.introReadOnly: Proofs residents sent and where each stands. Finance verifies them.

empty.needs_information: No proof is waiting for a resident
empty.awaiting_bank_evidence: No proof is waiting for its bank line

inbox.emptyBody: Proofs appear here as residents send them from the resident app.

review.title: Proof from {{name}}
review.matchTitle: Find the money in the bank
review.matchBody: Choose the bank transfer this proof is about. Each shows why it was proposed.
review.noCandidates: No bank transfer looks like this proof yet.
review.taken: Already settles payment {{payment}}. A transfer can settle only one payment.
review.sharedRef_one: Another transfer has the same reference text. It is a different transfer, not a copy.
review.sharedRef_other: {{count}} other transfers have the same reference text. They are different transfers, not copies.
review.allocationBody: Only lines {{payer}} is liable for, oldest first. Anything left becomes credit.
review.overrideHelp: Required when you change what the rule proposed.
review.allocationRule: Lines of another payer or another association can never be chosen.
review.verifySummary: Verify {{amount}} and issue the receipt. Credit left: {{unapplied}}.
review.infoHelp: The resident sees this message and can send the proof again.
review.infoSuggestion: The photo is not clear. Please upload the bank's PDF receipt or a clearer screenshot.
review.rejectEffect: The resident sees the reason. No payment or receipt is created.
review.rejectToast: Proof rejected; the resident sees why
review.verifiedBody: {{amount}} recorded with receipt {{receipt}}. Account balance now {{balance}}.
review.verifiedCredit: {{amount}} is kept as credit for this payer.
review.duplicateTitle: This may have been sent before
review.duplicateBody: Same file, or same amount, date and reference as: {{refs}}. Check the bank line before verifying.
review.readOnly: You can see this proof; verifying it is for finance.
review.alreadyMatchedHelp: Choose the transfer that is still free, ask the resident for information, or reject the proof as a copy.
review.wrongAccount: Received on account {{iban}}, not the association's account in force that day. It can never settle this proof.
review.wrongEntity: Received by another association. It can never settle this proof.
review.awaitOption: Not on a statement yet: wait for the bank line
review.awaitOptionBody: Mark it as checked. Nothing is settled, allocated or receipted until the transfer appears on an imported statement.
review.awaitNoteHelp: At least 10 characters. Kept with the proof; the resident does not see it.
review.awaitToast: Marked as checked. It waits for the bank line.
review.awaitingTitle: Checked by {{name}}: waiting for the bank line
review.awaitingBody: Nothing is settled yet. When a statement with this transfer is imported, choose the transfer below and verify.
review.exceptionTitle: This transfer matches only in part
review.exceptionBody: It does not match on: {{list}}. Settling against it needs an exception approved by someone else.
review.exceptionReason: Why this transfer is this resident's payment
review.exceptionReasonHelp: At least 20 characters: what you checked, and with whom.
review.exceptionYours: You asked for this exception, so someone else must decide it.
review.exceptionWaiting: A treasurer decides it. The transfer is held for this proof meanwhile.
review.exceptionRejectEffect: The transfer is released and the proof goes back for review.
review.exceptionRejectedToast: Exception rejected. The proof is back for review.
review.chooseFull: Verifying needs a transfer that matches fully. For a partial match, ask for an exception.

payments.intro: Every verified payment, how it was confirmed, what it settled and its receipt.
payments.searchPlaceholder: Name, flat, account, payment or receipt number
payments.emptyBody: Payments appear when a proof is verified or cash is received at the office.

payment.creditTargets_one: {{amount}} can settle {{count}} open line of the same payer:
payment.creditTargets_other: {{amount}} can settle {{count}} open lines of the same payer:
payment.creditNothingOpen: {{amount}} stays as credit until this payer has a new bill.
payment.cashNoLine: Cash at the counter: it appears on the bank statement only once deposited.
payment.exceptionBody: Requested by {{requested}}, approved by {{approved}}. Did not match: {{list}}.

office.title: Record an office payment
office.subtitle: Cash handed over at the society office. A receipt is issued straight away.
office.disabledTitle: Cash is not accepted at this site
office.disabledBody: The committee has not turned on office cash. It can be turned on under the site's payment methods.

credits.intro: Money received but not settling any charge yet: paid ahead, or more than was owed.
credits.emptyBody: Nobody has paid more than they owed.

agingPage.intro: What is still owed on {{date}}, by how late it is. Credit is shown apart, never netted.
agingPage.emptyBody: Choose another group to see who owes what.

statementPage.intro: Choose an account to see its charges, credit notes and payments.
statementPage.pickBody: The statement shows the balance brought forward, charges, credit notes, payments and the closing balance.

bank.intro: The association's bank statement lines. A transfer is identified by the bank's own transaction id, never by its reference text.
bank.importBody: Import the sample statement, or a CSV in the same columns. Importing a statement twice adds nothing twice.
bank.importColumns: Columns: txn_id, value_date, amount, narration, reference, counterparty, counterparty_account
bank.alreadyImported: This statement was imported before. Nothing was added.
bank.excludeEffect: It is not a resident's payment (for example a refund or bank charge). It can be restored.
bank.emptyBody: Import a statement or choose another group.
bank.accountHelp: The statement is bound to this account. A file for another account is refused.
bank.nowMatchable_one: {{count}} waiting proof now has its bank line: {{refs}}
bank.nowMatchable_other: {{count}} waiting proofs now have their bank line: {{refs}}

reconciliation.intro: The statement against the payments: what is matched, what is not, and the proofs waiting for their bank line.
reconciliation.allMatched: Every line is matched or set aside.
reconciliation.awaitingTitle: Proofs waiting for their bank line
reconciliation.noneAwaiting: None: no proof is waiting for a statement.

settings.payeeHint: The only account residents are shown. It belongs to the association, never to PropertyOS.
settings.platformNote: Residents' money goes only to the association's own verified account. The platform's account never appears here.
settings.proposeHint: A second person approves it; residents see it only after the cooling-off period.
settings.ibanHelp: Pakistani IBAN, e.g. PK00 DEMO 0000 0000 0000 0000 (demo bank code DEMO only).
settings.letterChecked: I have checked the bank's confirmation letter for this account
settings.proposed: Proposed; waiting for a second person
settings.pendingBody: Proposed by {{name}}. The person who proposed it cannot approve it.
settings.coolingBody: During the cooling-off period residents keep seeing the current account.
settings.endCoolingNote: Demo only: the prototype's date does not move, so the cooling-off period can be ended by hand to see the change reach residents.
settings.rejectEffect: Residents keep the current account. The proposal stays in the history.
settings.cancelEffect: Residents keep the current account. The cancellation is recorded.

done.end-cooling-off: The new account is now shown to residents

settings.methodsHint: Which ways residents may pay. Bank transfer is always offered; office cash only when turned on here.
settings.postingTitle: Who may post an approved billing run
settings.postingHint: Only these roles may post, and only after another person has approved the run.
settings.postingRule: The person who prepared a run can never post or approve it.
settings.numberingHint: Per issuing association and site. Changes apply to new documents only; issued numbers never change.
settings.tokens: Use {code}, {yyyy}, {yyyymm} and {seq:N} (N = 3–6 digits). Every document but a run needs {seq:N}.

grouping.account_payer: One invoice per billing account and person responsible for paying (each flat keeps its own lines).
grouping.payer: One invoice per payer across their flats.

settings.groupingHint: Per-flat or per-payer invoices are supported by the model and offered in a later stage.
settings.readOnly: You can see these settings; changing them is for the treasurer or administrator.
settings.methodsLimit: Most the office takes in one receipt
settings.methodsLimitHelp: The society's own rule. 50,000 is only this demo's starting value.
settings.methodsCounter: Where and when residents can pay

problems.amount: Enter an amount above zero (up to two decimals).
problems.amountMismatch: The bank received {{bank}}; the payment must be that amount.
problems.overrideReason: Say why this allocation differs from the rule (at least 5 characters).
problems.cross_payer_forbidden: That line belongs to another payer. A payment settles only the payer's own lines.
problems.cross_entity_forbidden: That line belongs to another association. A payment never crosses associations.
problems.cross_account_forbidden: That line is on another billing account.
problems.over_line: More than the line's open amount.
problems.over_amount: The allocation is more than the money received.
problems.invalidState: This proof cannot be changed in its current state.
problems.bankLineAlreadyMatched: Bank transaction {{txn}} already settles payment {{payment}}. A transfer can settle only one payment.
problems.bankLineExcluded: That bank line was set aside.
problems.messageRequired: Write what you need (at least 10 characters).
problems.methodNotAllowed: This payment method is not allowed at this site.
problems.overCashLimit: More than the office takes in cash ({{limit}}).
problems.payer: Choose a person who pays for a flat on this account.
problems.noCredit: There is no credit left on this payment.
problems.nothingOpen: This payer has nothing open to settle.
problems.fileDates: The statement needs its first and last date.
problems.fileRows: Some lines have no transaction id, date or amount.
problems.iban: Enter a Pakistani IBAN with the demo bank code DEMO (PK + 2 digits + DEMO + 16 digits).
problems.ibanSame: That is already the account in force.
problems.changePending: A change is already waiting. Decide or cancel it first.
problems.accountNotVerified: Check the bank's confirmation letter before approving.
problems.methodLater: This method arrives in a later stage.
problems.pattern_sequence: The pattern needs a sequence ({seq:N}); a run's needs {yyyymm}.
problems.dateFuture: The transfer date cannot be in the future.
problems.dateTooOld: That date is before the society started billing here.
problems.reference: Enter the reference you used (at least 4 characters).
problems.fileRequired: Choose the transfer receipt (image or PDF).
problems.fileType: Use a JPG, PNG, WebP image or a PDF.
problems.fileSize: The file must be 5 MB or smaller.
problems.bankEvidenceRequired: Choose the bank transfer from an imported statement. A note is not evidence of the money.
problems.exceptionRequired: This transfer matches only in part ({{missing}}). Ask for an exception instead.
problems.exceptionNotNeeded: This transfer matches fully: verify it directly.
problems.awaitNote: Write what you checked (at least 10 characters).
problems.wrongDestination: Transfer {{txn}} reached account {{iban}}, not the association's account in force that day. It cannot settle this proof.
problems.bankLineHeld: This transfer is held for an exception on {{ref}}.
problems.statementAccount: Choose the association account this statement belongs to.
problems.statementAccountMismatch: This statement is for account {{file}}, not {{chosen}}. Choose the right account.
